title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Westfield Sleep Clinic under your health plan for services provided on June 4, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Your plan requires pre-certification for the polysomnography sleep study. Our records show no approved authorization on file for this date of service. Reason code: CO-197.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,140.25 billed. The provider may bill you for this service.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Verdane Health Plan, Appeals Unit, PO Box 73307, Buffalo, NY 14202. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-0678.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
